name: Hesitation
source:
Tonight you will go see your lover.
Take care in choosing what you'll bring.

Hesitation is a short narrative game where you piece together the story by interacting with the items in a small room. But take care! There are more items than you have time to explore and some may prevent you from taking others.

[[url=https://k-ramstack.itch.io/hesitation]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今晚，你将前去见你的恋人。
请慎重挑选你要带去的东西。

《Hesitation》是一款短篇叙事游戏，你将通过与狭小房间里的各类物品互动来拼凑出完整的故事。但请务必留神！房间里的物品数量远超你所能探索的时间，而且拿走某些物品可能会使你无法再带走其他东西。

[摘自[url=https://k-ramstack.itch.io/hesitation]itch.io[/url]]
